# SoilGrids 2.0: # This is not a file of ISRIC's. Each cell is the mean of the 5000 m grids' pixels under a lattice of 10 by 10 points across it
the top 5 cm of the soil: sand: projected as the grids are; a cell is kept if at least 10% of its points have a soil.

# SoilGrids 2.0: # A row is a cell. lat and lon are its south-west corner
the top 5 cm of the soil: sand: and it runs half a degree north and east of them. land is the share of its points that have a soil.
silt and clay are percent of the fine earth by mass; coarse is percent of the soil by volume in fragments coarser than 2 mm. ISRIC gives each in tenths of a percent (g/kg
which downloads the four grids below and checks each one's sha256 against the one ISRIC publishes beside it.

# SoilGrids 2.0: # They are the mean predictions for 0 to 5 cm
